peergrade_reviews.feedback: Loved the introduction, the music and sound effects did a good job. I enjoyed the song you used as well, it really brought the tech vibe. The editing of sound and voice seemed very good for me as well. If I had to point something for improvement it would be the sounds in the introduction: even tho I really like them, I feel they took a litle bit longer than I would put it. But the work is great!

I enjoyed this submission a lot! All elements of the podcast are well integrated with eachother and fit perfectly with the chosen theme. The sound effects are well placed with a pleasant amount of volume that do not interfere with your speech, and the songs used perfectly capture the emotions you wanted to transmit, whether you were describing the process of social engineering or warning people to be more mindful of suspicious links. Your voice is perfectly audible, and the volume of the songs is adequate. I am by no means an audio/podcast expert, but I enjoyed this submission a lot! Please take all offered feedback with a grain of salt due to my inexperience in the audio/podcast field!

Just by the description and the start, one can tell that it is a very interesting podcast. The sound effects and music set the tone, and the hook of putting the listener in a position and narrating in a second-person point of view constructs a strong context for understanding the not-so-known concept of social engineering. The low voice matches the intended effect perfectly at the beginning. The narrative line is nice, giving a problem-solution story, and a lesson for the audience.
